articles.title: Crypto exchanges tout cold storage ratios after Binance attack
articles.snippet: Coinbase says it keeps more than 99% of customer assets offline, while Gate reports 88.26% of its total assets are kept in cold storage.

articles.title: Binance, Deribit revoke SignalPlus API keys after fake Teams invite attack
articles.snippet: SignalPlus said attackers compromised an engineer’s computer in a breach that resulted in losses of less than $82,000, which the crypto trading platform pledged to reimburse in full.

articles.title: Fed, OCC check US banks after Binance hack as experts flag security risks
articles.snippet: US regulators reportedly contacted banks following last week’s $6.3 billion Binance security hack, while experts raised concerns about transaction security and crypto risks.

articles.title: $3.1B in Stolen Binance Crypto Has Yet to Be Laundered: Elliptic
articles.snippet: The attackers have used more than 20,000 wallets on 16 blockchains so far, but the bulk of the stolen ETH and Bitcoin hasn't moved.

articles.title: US Voters Back AI Data Center Restrictions in At Least 29 Communities
articles.snippet: Voters across the United States backed measures to curb data centers, raising new obstacles for the infrastructure powering AI as electricity bills, water supplies, and public oversight dominate the debate.
